title: focuser_primaluce showed the requested position as the value in the first BUSY update of a move
summary: FOCUSER_POSITION and ROTATOR_POSITION were dispatched with INDIGO_COPY_VALUES_PROCESS_CHANGE, so the request replaced the measured value and the first BUSY update showed the target for one update before the first readback.
evidence: 20261023111747-3b69-primaluce-rotator-progress/verification.md (FND-002); hardware log 2026-10-23 (BUSY value 17 for a move from 10 to 17)

resolution.evidence: 20261023111747-3b69-primaluce-rotator-progress/verification.md: FOCUSER_POSITION and ROTATOR_POSITION use preserve_values (targets only); absolute_move and the rotator move cases check the first BUSY value and fail without it; recorded run 65/65; hardware first BUSY value is the measured angle.
